gen-gf-warnes-gf-gidole: Warnes stretches out wide and bold, its ink strokes tapering away before they touch. Gidole follows in a plain sans, its lines drawn like neon tube and its terminals held apart.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-golos-text: Stretched, flat-toned letters with tapering ink strokes give Warnes its loud, spacious look up top. And Golos Text fills each line with a tall x-height and a widely parted s, which makes the whole pairing feel friendly and current.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Expressive is the first word for Warnes, whose unshaded outlines and wide spacing make a loud entrance. Hedvig Letters Sans replies in quieter sans, with a wide gap in each c and small letters that nearly reach capital height.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-heebo: Heebo reads neutral and professional, with a tall central band of text and curves that stop short instead of closing. Warnes sits above it with flat, contrast-free letterforms, so the sans-serif body steadies the display heading's wide, bold stride.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-guntur: Expressive and bold, Warnes lets its ink strokes taper out and its spacing stretch wide. And Hind Guntur lines up beneath as a modern sans-serif with stamped-metal lowercase and wide gaps at its curve ends; give the heading plenty more size than the text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-madurai: Wide, flat, fearless lettering, with Warnes tapering its ink strokes and spreading its spacing far apart. Hind Madurai sits below in plain sans, with lowercase that fills the line.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-mysuru: Loud and stretched out, Warnes tapers its ink strokes and shows no thick-thin shift at all. Hind Mysuru is the workhorse, a sans-serif whose lowercase presses toward the ascender height and whose a keeps its mouth ajar.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-siliguri: Big, loose, ink-tapered letters with spacious tracking set the mood for Warnes, which has no stroke contrast. Hind Siliguri hums along in sans-serif with constant line weight.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-vadodara: Professional, though Warnes is anything but quiet. Its ink strokes taper out before touching and its tracking stretches wide, while Hind Vadodara answers in a sans-serif with unchanging thickness and open, tall-bowled e and a shapes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-huninn: Warnes has no stroke contrast at all, just ink strokes that taper away before touching, spaced out wide and bold. Huninn takes over in plain sans, steady and modern.
